claims.value: New explicit operator constraint: replace the open-ended longer-alpha action with one 30-minute dev-only alpha soak that makes no production changes and adds no durable controller persistence. Keep batch 128 as the initial ceiling while fetch adapts. Acceptance requires at least 900 PGCR/sec steady throughput during the final 10 minutes, zero integrity or recovery violations, no DB connection failure storm, and a successful controlled-stop restart from DB truth. Abort and roll back if MySQL exceeds 90% of host memory for two consecutive minutes or DB connection failures exceed three per minute.

Integrity and authority remain distinct: PVE34 and adaptive-autonomy results are historical evidence, while the 30-minute budget and numeric gates are a new operator mandate rather than an observed production result. The mandate does not supersede the integrity model: DB rows remain truth, raw markers commit with summaries, failed rows retry immediately, DB/cache availability failure stops the parser, restart fills gaps normally, protected state stays unchanged, and no rebuild/recompute, parser-state correctness table, Cortex-to-DB replay, production mutation, or durable controller persistence is permitted.

answer.answer: Revised child checkpoint: use three separate level-0 Base Cores; construction remains gated on verifying each core’s complete heat load.

claims.value: The recovered parent architecture is an Update 1-only distributed backbone-and-spurs network with protected core hubs, modular processing cells, mining spurs, and substantial margin below each level-0 core’s 1,000 heat capacity; the earlier monolithic mega-base was superseded.

The child requirement is one Constructorizer and two Facturers with every Base Core at level 0 and Fire Wave protection preserved. Their machine heat is 500 + 650 + 650 = 1,800. A single level-0 core provides only 1,000 capacity, so neither Constructorizer + Facturer (1,150) nor two Facturers (1,300) may share a core; both arrangements exceed capacity and disable protection.

The safe revised layout uses at least three occupied level-0 cores: Core A hosts the Constructorizer at 500 heat, leaving 500 capacity; Core B hosts Facturer 1 at 650 heat, leaving 350; Core C hosts Facturer 2 at 650 heat, leaving 350. No heavy machines are co-located, and all supporting buildings plus existing load must fit inside the stated per-core remainder so no occupied core exceeds 1,000.

Before construction, verify in the live Update 1 build menu that the Constructorizer, Facturer, required recipes, power sources, and logistics components are actually available, then record each target core’s existing load and add all supporting-building heat. Build only if Core A remains at or below 1,000 with at least its 500-heat Constructorizer and Cores B/C each remain at or below 1,000 with their 650-heat Facturer; do not substitute hidden, future, pre-Update-1, or unverified amplifier capacity.

answer.answer: Checkpoint advanced from evaluation to the first persistent API implementation slice.

claims.value: Straylight is a user-owned, portable, agent-first context and durable-work layer that preserves learned knowledge and live resumable state—including evidence, decisions, plans, artifacts, computations, checkpoints, and next actions—so later agents can inspect, revise, and advance work.

The earlier result—about 1,070 mean estimated tokens for one-shot BM25 versus 2,932 for the workspace—shows the BM25 regression fixture matched 17/20 cases and recovered 48/53 evidence items, versus 17/20 and 46/53 for workspace policy 0.2. It must not be interpreted as an uncached-input advantage for the new API: cumulative cached replay and uncached input were not separated and must now be reported independently.

The first persistent build slice is a typed, snapshot-pinned workspace that reopens a revision-N parent checkpoint, refreshes to N+1 with an evidence/constraint diff, supports batched query/read using exact and lexical retrieval plus a pluggable semantic path, and commits an immutable child checkpoint containing its parent ID and source references without reconstructing the complete prior corpus.

The implementation transition passes when each harness case completes in no more than four workspace calls, matches the direct-filesystem answer claims, reports cumulative cached replay separately from uncached input, exposes the N-to-N+1 diff, and persists an immutable lineage-bearing child checkpoint; the BM25 shell remains only a regression fixture.
